The Green Globes certification program for data centers emphasizes sustainability, efficiency, and stakeholder transparency. It supports all stages of a data center's lifecycle, from design to operation, and provides flexibility, speed to certification, and eligibility for funding incentives. The certification process is designed to meet the complex needs of data centers, especially amidst increasing demand for AI-driven computational power.
